meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, studies of company finances (DBIE, via the local Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Each study is final for its own sample of companies; a later study re-measures the earlier year on a different sample, kept beside it, never chained.
meta.coverage: Private limited companies: financial ratios, by industry, from the RBI's annual studies (2020-21 to 2024-25 studies)
meta.note: Each year's figure is from that year's own study: the companies in the study, this year against last year for growth rates. Consecutive years are different samples; read the level of a rate across years, never a rupee level. Ratios in per cent except those marked times.
